football.inputs: Prior home and away goals, fixture dates, identities, and venue
football.application: Estimate a football scoreline or goal differential
football.incompatible: Raw rugby/NFL points or any current fixture outcome
football.applicability_condition: Use regulation-time association-football goals, venue/competition scope and data available by cutoff. Specify extra-time handling.

count.inputs: Historical football goals or rugby tries, exposure and fixture identifiers
count.application: Model goal or try counts at a fixed exposure
count.incompatible: Raw rugby points as unweighted event counts
count.applicability_condition: Use football goals or rugby tries, or another explicitly defined event count with exposure. Weighted rugby/NFL points require their own observation model.

paired.inputs: Prior contest outcomes, participants, rules, dates and venue when specified
paired.application: Estimate relative strength from comparable opponent results
paired.incompatible: Unresolved draws passed to binary likelihood or unknown future lineups
paired.applicability_condition: Prior same-format opponent results and stable identities. For football/rugby/NFL state draw handling. Tennis and darts require consistent match format.

series.inputs: Timestamped preceding sport measurements with their observation and availability times
series.application: Track changes in prior football chance-creation rates, horse sectionals, tennis serve rates, rugby try rates, NFL drive efficiency or darts checkout rates
series.incompatible: Centered windows, retrospective vendor corrections and whole-season fit parameters unavailable at cutoff
series.applicability_condition: Use a sport-specific prior sequence with calendar or exposure alignment. Candidate inputs include football chance creation, racing sectionals, tennis serve points, rugby tries, NFL drives and darts checkout attempts.

simulation.inputs: Specified simulator or scenario law, historical state inputs and reproducible random seeds where used
simulation.application: Summarize rule-consistent scoring or rank trajectories
simulation.incompatible: Simulators calibrated with target results or invented missing transition data
simulation.applicability_condition: Conditional research tool. Specify rules, simulator inputs, objective, scenario law and downstream use for the sport.

forecast.inputs: Archived forecasts on aligned events and targets; older labels only when fitting
forecast.application: Combine, calibrate or compare forecasts for the same sporting event target
forecast.incompatible: Mismatched horizons or labels from the event being predicted
forecast.applicability_condition: Require archived as-issued probabilities or logits on a common event space and earlier settled labels where fitting is required.

binary.inputs: Historically available features and older binary outcomes or prespecified likelihoods
binary.application: Estimate or update a binary event such as a tennis service hold or a football clean sheet
binary.incompatible: Multiclass results passed as binary without a stated recoding
binary.applicability_condition: Define the binary endpoint and training label at event level. Document draws, scratches, pushes or rule exceptions where applicable.

success.inputs: Ordered observable attempts with success labels and exposure counts from earlier events
success.application: Model tennis service points, darts checkout attempts or comparable bounded event rates
success.incompatible: Current-event attempts in a pre-match specification
success.applicability_condition: Require comparable opportunities and a stable denominator. Check independence, heterogeneity or finite-population sampling as the definition requires.

choice.inputs: Declared field available at cutoff, entrant scores or covariates, earlier winner labels if fitting
choice.application: Assign a mutually exclusive winner probability across a race field
choice.incompatible: Later scratches and dead heats without explicit target rules
choice.applicability_condition: Horse racing needs complete as-of declared fields, runner covariates, scratch policy and winner/field linkage.

rank.inputs: Event-time declared fields and historical finishing orders including tie and withdrawal policy
rank.application: Estimate probabilities of horse finishing orders
rank.incompatible: Excluded runners or ties treated as arbitrary ordered finishers
rank.applicability_condition: Require observed and comparable finish orders with a stated dead-heat, nonfinisher and scratch policy.

positive.inputs: Positive comparable historical race or point durations
positive.application: Transform skewed duration predictors for model fitting
positive.applicability_condition: Require positive comparable racing or tennis durations with clock rules, censoring and explicit support.

assessment.inputs: Authorized development records and, where the statistic requires them, archived as-issued predictions paired with settled labels
assessment.application: Assess calibration or forecast quality in a permitted historical assessment sample
assessment.incompatible: Same-event outcome as a feature or any reserved evaluation data
assessment.applicability_condition: Retrospective assessment only. Align settled labels, archived forecasts and event origins on permitted development records.

survival.inputs: Time origin, historical at-risk durations, availability-as-of indicators, censoring and causes when specified
survival.application: Estimate time to a future withdrawal or return in records with defensible risk sets
survival.incompatible: Backfilled event states or treating censored records as failures
survival.applicability_condition: Require risk-set entry, time origin, censoring and competing-event rules. Match the endpoint and timing to the competition.

resampling.inputs: Authorized earlier event-level units, chronology and dependence-group identifiers
resampling.application: Estimate uncertainty of a statistic such as average football scoring error
resampling.incompatible: Reusing reserved holdout rows or ignoring repeated-player dependence
resampling.applicability_condition: Choose the sport's resampling unit and dependence structure. Repeated athletes, teams, meetings or seasons can invalidate row resampling.

continuous.inputs: Earlier features and continuous measurements such as duration, margin or rates defined on completed training events
continuous.application: Predict a continuous sport target like race time or score differential
continuous.incompatible: Outcome-derived predictors or a continuous output used directly as a class probability
continuous.applicability_condition: Require a meaningful continuous target or residual, defined units and an earlier fit. Generic method transfer depends on support and observation design.

multifeature.inputs: Comparable numeric features from timestamped prior performances
multifeature.application: Summarize correlated form metrics or group similar historical performances
multifeature.incompatible: Whole-season fit or features computed from target-event observations
multifeature.applicability_condition: Conditional on a sport-specific design, matrix, graph, objective or time series. Pure numerical algorithms are components of an analysis.

graph.inputs: Dated opponent graph edges, weights and explicit direction convention
graph.incompatible: Edges from fixtures played after the forecast cutoff
graph.applicability_condition: Require a dated graph with defensible edge direction, weights and eligible competitors.

margin.inputs: Prior competitor IDs and score differentials in comparable units
margin.application: Fit margin-based strengths as inputs to a separate forecast model
margin.incompatible: Combining raw margins from incompatible rulesets
margin.applicability_condition: Use comparable signed margins and competition scope with explicit treatment of schedule strength and blowouts.

assignment.inputs: Pre-event eligible roster, historical role features and allowed assignments
assignment.application: Compare hypothetical role assignments to study lineup sensitivity
assignment.incompatible: Using actual later lineups as if known beforehand
assignment.applicability_condition: Require an explicit permitted team or scheduling decision, feasible assignments, constraints and a meaningful cost.

market.inputs: Synthetic hypothetical probability and decimal payout, or licensed and timestamped archival inputs only
market.application: Compare abstract decision-theoretic quantities under fixed hypothetical quotes
market.incompatible: Live quotes, real wagering instructions, or unlicensed price histories
market.applicability_condition: Hypothetical decision math requires coherent settlement, probability and quote at the same cutoff, with costs and voids treated explicitly.

darts.inputs: Double-out rules, known simulated visit state and earlier target/impact records
darts.application: Estimate probability of finishing a visit at a given remainder
darts.incompatible: Future actual throw locations or a different checkout rule
darts.applicability_condition: Require double-out visit rules, remainder and darts in hand, plus historical target/impact records.

tennis.inputs: Earlier server point-win estimates and event scoring rules
tennis.application: Map a service-point propensity to service-game probability
tennis.incompatible: Target match point outcomes or no-ad rules
tennis.applicability_condition: Require advantage scoring and comparable serve-point observations. Apply the formula at the game level.

timestamps.inputs: Historical event timestamps, clock intervals, exposure definitions and source release times
timestamps.application: Estimate clustering in prior goals, tries or drive outcomes
timestamps.incompatible: Later goals or clock events used in pre-match intensity
timestamps.applicability_condition: Require clock/exposure alignment and publication times. Use goals, tries or drive endpoints with explicit gap/reset assumptions.

causal.inputs: Authorized historical settled outcomes and exposures, pre-treatment confounders, eligibility, and observation/availability timestamps
causal.application: Study a pre-event intervention such as a lineup change or a schedule/rest exposure
causal.incompatible: Post-treatment covariates as confounders or unmeasured assignment assumed random
causal.applicability_condition: Retrospective effect estimation. Require historical outcomes, earlier covariates and design-specific identification. Explain treatment timing and interference.

categories.inputs: Historical grouped outcome counts with exclusive categories
categories.application: Model overdispersion of prior outcome-type frequencies
categories.applicability_condition: Require stable mutually exclusive states or outcomes and a declared transition clock when relevant.

composition.inputs: Earlier strictly positive shares or prespecified bin frequencies from available sport measurements
composition.application: Compare composition of scoring patterns or drift of historical feature bins
composition.incompatible: Zeros without explicit handling or inconsistent category denominators
composition.applicability_condition: Require coherent parts with a common denominator and a declared zero policy.

tracking.inputs: Licensed earlier timestamped position observations at fixed sampling intervals
tracking.application: Derive historical pace or speed features from past tracking
tracking.incompatible: Live or future tracking of a target event in a pre-event predictor
tracking.applicability_condition: Require legal tracking access, a shared coordinate system, timestamps and a motion model appropriate to the observed interval.
